title: An exciting week …
excerpt: After a great weekend in Dallas, training people in leading learning circles for We Make the Road by Walking , today I’ll be at the White House as part of a symposium there on LGBT equality and human rights. Then I’ll be off to Wild Goose Festival . Hope to see many of you there.
